listing.name: Battle Arena Toshinden — Battle Arena Toshinden Recompiled (NJH-1001)
listing.summary: The project offers playable setup packages. Coverage of every fighter and mode is unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA disc. The catalog identifies SCUS94003, while the supported disc boot file is SCUS_942.00 and the runtime ID is SCUS94200. Follow the project’s exact disc requirements rather than treating those identifiers as interchangeable.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the v0.1.0 setup ZIP for your system and follow its instructions to compile the game locally with its toolchain.

warnings: The project offers playable setup packages. Coverage of every fighter and mode is unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
